Hi Alex answers inline and next steps:

- Default quickstart limits: 60 requests/min and 10,000 tokens/min. These are intentionally conservative for new keys.
- Yes we can provision a short-lived, IP-restricted quickstart key for the POC. Please confirm the IP ranges or domains to restrict to.
- Data handling: Hosted API logs are retained for troubleshooting; we offer options to opt out of retention for specific keys and can provide SOC 2 evidence. I'll send our security summary in a separate thread / doc if needed.
- Dedicated: typical lead time to stand up a Dedicated pool for a new customer is 2-4 weeks depending on sizing and contract; for POC you can use Hosted and then migrate.

Next steps I can do today:
1) Provision a restricted quickstart key (expires in 30 days) please confirm IPs/domains.
2) Share a short config snippet for the /v1/chat and /v1/generate endpoints (below).

Example curl (streaming):

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.1","input":"Summarize...","max_tokens":256}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

I've re-attached: redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf

If you'd like, Aditya can join a short session to help configure batching and tokens to match your test traffic.

Best,
Neha
